xmldoc.short_description: Split datetime or duration values into hour, minute, and second components.

param_input_item.param_description: datetime, duration, serial date number, or date-compatible input.

param_output_item.param_description: Three double arrays containing hour, minute, and second values.

description.p: Split datetime or duration values into hour, minute, and second components.
For duration input, the hour part may exceed 23 because it represents elapsed hours. For datetime input, the hour part is the time-of-day hour.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.

example_item.example_item_data: [h, m, s] = hms(duration(27, 5, 6)) [h, m, s] = hms(datetime(2024, 5, 17, 13, 14, 15))
